name: HRC_SEM_EDUCATIONS
description: This table contains education information for the person.

columns.name: EDUCATION_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of table education.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: This is the foreign key to person table.

columns.name: DEGREE_LEVEL
columns.description: This is the education level of the person.

columns.name: FIELD_OF_STUDY
columns.description: This is the field study of the person.

columns.name: INSTITUTION_NAME
columns.description: This column contains the institution name.

columns.name: INSTITUTION_CITY
columns.description: This column contains the institution city.

columns.name: INSTITUTION_STATE
columns.description: This column contains the institution state.

columns.name: INSTITUTION_COUNTRY
columns.description: This column contains the instituion country.

columns.name: SCHOOL
columns.description: This is the school of the person.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: This column describes the end date of the education.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This column describes the end date of the education.

columns.name: CURRENT_EDUCATION
columns.description: This column indicates if education is current.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
